exposure.backgrounds: Training uses two traffic and two meeting captures. Transfer uses separate washing, river and restaurant capture sessions. Excerpts and condition copies remain dependent.
exposure.generators: Piper and Kitten stock synthesis appear in both old and transfer cohorts.
exposure.physical_reader_identity: Cross-corpus physical identity remains unresolved; publisher groups and exact PCM are distinct.
exposure.training_calibration: Old MLS stock-synthesis panel with separately grouped readers and genuine donors.
exposure.transfer: Separate native LibriSpeech cohort, fresh to the fitted correction. All inputs had prior earlier-copy comparator use. Four foreground recordings had prior standalone recurrent-view testing.

method.calibration: Four separate ordinary foreground groups and eight admitted background-only files. Strict point uses highest ordinary group maximum and background floor. Wider point uses second-highest group maximum with the same floor.
method.fitting: Balanced fitting-source, condition and class logistic loss plus half-weight same-clock synthetic-versus-genuine ranking. Ridge0.05 on standardized coefficients, zero penalty on intercept, nonnegative original-score coefficient. Standardization uses fitting rows only.
method.readout: Both adjacent750ms readings exceed the point. Each original750ms interval remains separate. Combined arms retain all current two-second intervals.

public_replay_scope: Public review checks aggregate arithmetic, source-group denominators, role coverage and gate. Native inputs, independent feature reconstruction, fitting and exact case outcomes were verified locally. The whole-study commitment binds the private custody manifest without exposing recording fingerprints.
status: Frozen local research comparison. Product behavior and overall confidence remain unchanged.
